description: This file is the main React component for the application's front-end interface, handling user interactions, state management, document uploads, persona data rendering, and workflow progression for a persona generation tool.

methods.name: mapDraftToPersonaData
methods.description: Maps draft data to the persona data structure for rendering.

methods.name: validateFile
methods.description: Validates uploaded files based on type or size criteria.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles user file input changes, initiating validation and upload.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds selected files to the upload queue.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Processes files dropped via drag-and-drop into the upload area.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Handles the drag over event to prevent default behaviors.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file from the upload list.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Triggers the generation of a persona draft based on uploaded documents.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves user-made changes to persona data.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the persona creation process, likely calling external APIs.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a specified skill from the persona data.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona data.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the profile image.

methods.name: removeExperience
methods.description: Removes a specified experience entry from persona data.
